title: Polymorphic potential of SRF binding site of c-Fos gene promoter: in vitro study.
authors: Profantova, Barbora; Rimal, Vaclav; Profant, Vaclav; Socha, Ondrej; Barvik, Ivan; Stepankova, Helena; Stepanek, Josef
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过NMR和分子动力学模拟解析c-Fos基因启动子SRF结合位点形成发夹/十字结构的机制，虽非直接TF-DNA复合物建模，但聚焦TF靶序列的非经典DNA构象与识别潜力，方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作研究。
abstract: Recently published in vivo observations have highlighted the presence of cruciform structures within the genome, suggesting their potential significance in the rapid recognition of the target sequence for transcription factor binding. In this in vitro study, we investigate the organization and stability of the sense (coding) strand within the Serum Response Element of the c-Fos gene promoter (c-Fos SRE), specifically focusing on segments spanning 12 to 36 nucleotides, centered around the CArG-box. Through a thorough examination of UV absorption patterns with varying temperatures, we identified the emergence of a remarkably stable structure, which we conclusively characterized as a hairpin using complementary (1)H NMR experiments. Our research decisively ruled out the formation of homoduplexes, as confirmed by supplementary fluorescence experiments. Utilizing molecular dynamics simulations with atomic distance constraints derived from NMR data, we explored the structural intricacies of the compact hairpin. Notably, the loop consisting of the six-membered A/T sequence demonstrated substantial stabilization through extensive stacking, non-canonical inter-base hydrogen bonding, and hydrophobic clustering of thymine methyl groups. These findings suggest the potential of the c-Fos SRE to adopt a cruciform structure (consisting of two opposing hairpins), potentially providing a topological recognition site for the SRF transcription factor under cellular conditions. Our results should inspire further biochemical and in vivo studies to explore the functional implications of these non-canonical DNA structures.
abstract_zh: 近期发表的体内观察研究强调了基因组中十字形结构的存在，提示其在转录因子结合靶序列快速识别中可能具有重要意义。在本体外研究中，我们考察了c-Fos基因启动子血清反应元件（c-Fos SRE）内有义（编码）链的组织与稳定性，特别聚焦于围绕CArG-box的12至36核苷酸片段。通过在不同温度下对紫外吸收模式的全面检查，我们识别出一种极为稳定结构的出现，并利用互补的(1)H NMR实验将其确凿表征为发夹结构。我们的研究明确排除了同源双链体的形成，这一点由补充荧光实验所证实。利用源自NMR数据的原子距离约束进行分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟，我们探索了紧凑发夹的结构细节。值得注意的是，由六元A/T序列组成的环通过广泛的堆叠、非经典碱基间氢键以及胸腺嘧啶甲基的疏水聚集表现出显著稳定性。这些发现表明，c-Fos SRE可能采用十字形结构（由两个相对的发夹组成），在细胞条件下可能为SRF转录因子提供拓扑识别位点。我们的结果应激发进一步的生物化学和体内研究，以探索这些非经典DNA结构的功能意义。
